meaning: setting X aside; regardless of X; X aside (let's focus on something else)

exercises.example_sentence: 味はともかく、この店は雰囲気が抜群だ。
exercises.translation: Taste aside, this restaurant's atmosphere is outstanding.
wrong_choice_explanations: はもちろん means 'X goes without saying, and…' and adds X to the praise; 味はもちろん would need 雰囲気も and praises the taste too, whereas the sentence sets the taste aside and praises only the atmosphere.
に限らず means 'not limited to X' and widens the scope to include X; 味に限らず would count the taste among the strengths, but the sentence deliberately leaves the taste out and singles out the atmosphere.
ばかりか means 'not only X but also…' and adds X to what follows; 味ばかりか would need 雰囲気も and imply the taste is also great — the opposite of setting it aside as はともかく does.
exercises.hiragana_full: あじはともかく、このみせはふんいきがばつぐんだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 味は別として、この店は雰囲気が最高だ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: あじはべつとして、このみせはふんいきがさいこうだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: おいしいかどうかはともかく、この店は居心地がいい。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: おいしいかどうかはともかく、このみせはいごこちがいい。

exercises.example_sentence: 結果はともかく、最後まで全力を尽くしたことに意味がある。
exercises.translation: Regardless of the outcome, there's meaning in having given it your all to the very end.
wrong_choice_explanations: はもちろん means 'X goes without saying, and…' and adds X to the praise; 結果はもちろん would make the result matter too, contradicting the point that effort counts whatever the outcome.
のみならず means 'not only X' and adds X to what follows; 結果のみならず would say the result matters as well as the effort, whereas the sentence sets the result aside to value effort alone.
に加えて means 'in addition to X' and stacks X on top of what follows; 結果に加えて would make the result count alongside the effort, the opposite of 'regardless of the outcome'.
exercises.hiragana_full: けっかはともかく、さいごまでぜんりょくをつくしたことにいみがある。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 勝敗はともかく、最後まで諦めなかったことが大事だ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: しょうはいはともかく、さいごまであきらめなかったことがだいじだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 結果はさておき、全力を出し切ったことに価値がある。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: けっかはさておき、ぜんりょくをだしきったことにかちがある。

vocab.meaning: to exhaust; to do to the utmost

exercises.example_sentence: 見た目はともかく、この製品の性能は申し分ない。
exercises.translation: Looks aside, this product's performance is impeccable.
wrong_choice_explanations: に限らず means 'not limited to X' and widens the scope to include X; 見た目に限らず would praise the looks too, but the sentence sets the looks aside and vouches only for the performance.
はもちろん means 'X goes without saying, and…' and adds X to the praise; 見た目はもちろん would need 性能も and praise the looks as obviously good, whereas はともかく leaves them out of the judgment.
のみならず means 'not only X' and adds X to what follows; 見た目のみならず would claim the looks are also excellent, but the sentence deliberately sets them aside to praise the performance.
exercises.hiragana_full: みためはともかく、このせいひんのせいのうはもうしぶんない。

audio_alternatives.kanji: デザインはともかく、この製品は機能が優れている。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: でざいんはともかく、このせいひんはきのうがすぐれている。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 見た目は別として、性能に関しては文句がない。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: みためはべつとして、せいのうにかんしてはもんくがない。

vocab.meaning: impeccable; leaving nothing to be desired

exercises.example_sentence: 料金はともかく、このホテルの接客は一流だ。
exercises.translation: Cost aside, this hotel's hospitality is first-rate.
wrong_choice_explanations: はもちろん means 'X goes without saying, and…' and adds X to the praise; 料金はもちろん would need 接客も and present the price as a plus, whereas the sentence sets the cost aside to praise only the service.
ばかりか means 'not only X but also…' and adds X to what follows; 料金ばかりか would need 接客も and imply the price is also first-rate — the opposite of leaving the cost out of the judgment.
に加えて means 'in addition to X' and stacks X on top of what follows; 料金に加えて would add the price to the praise, but the sentence sets the cost aside and rates only the hospitality.
exercises.hiragana_full: りょうきんはともかく、このほてるのせっきゃくはいちりゅうだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 値段はともかく、このホテルはもてなしが素晴らしい。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: ねだんはともかく、このほてるはもてなしがすばらしい。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 料金は別として、接客に関しては文句のつけようがない。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: りょうきんはべつとして、せっきゃくにかんしてはもんくのつけようがない。

exercises.example_sentence: 理由はともかく、遅刻したことは事実なのだから謝るべきだ。
exercises.translation: Whatever the reason, the fact is you were late, so you should apologize.
wrong_choice_explanations: のみならず means 'not only X' and adds X to what follows; 理由のみならず would say the reason matters as well, but the speaker dismisses the reason and insists on the plain fact of being late.
に限らず means 'not limited to X' and widens the scope to include X; 理由に限らず would bring the reason into consideration, whereas the sentence sets it aside: whatever it was, you should apologize.
はもちろん means 'X goes without saying, and…' and adds X to the praise; 理由はもちろん would make the reason count too, contradicting the point that the reason is irrelevant and an apology is owed anyway.
exercises.hiragana_full: りゆうはともかく、ちこくしたことはじじつなのだからあやまるべきだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 事情はともかく、約束の時間に遅れたのは間違いない。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: じじょうはともかく、やくそくのじかんにおくれたのはまちがいない。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 理由はさておき、遅刻した以上は謝るのが筋だ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: りゆうはさておき、ちこくしたいじょうはあやまるのがすじだ。

exercises.example_sentence: 勝ち負けはともかく、試合を楽しむことが一番だ。
exercises.translation: Winning or losing aside, enjoying the game is what matters most.
wrong_choice_explanations: はもちろん means 'X goes without saying, and…' and adds X to the praise; 勝ち負けはもちろん would make winning matter too, contradicting the claim that enjoying the game matters most.
に加えて means 'in addition to X' and stacks X on top of what follows; 勝ち負けに加えて would put winning alongside enjoyment, whereas the sentence sets winning aside so enjoyment can come first.
ばかりか means 'not only X but also…' and adds X to what follows; 勝ち負けばかりか would treat winning as important as well — the opposite of setting it aside as はともかく does.
exercises.hiragana_full: かちまけはともかく、しあいをたのしむことがいちばんだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 勝敗はともかく、みんなで試合を楽しめれば十分だ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: しょうはいはともかく、みんなでしあいをたのしめればじゅうぶんだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 勝つか負けるかは別として、この試合を心から楽しみたい。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: かつかまけるかはべつとして、このしあいをこころからたのしみたい。

exercises.example_sentence: 細かい点はともかく、全体の方針には異論はない。
exercises.translation: Setting aside the fine details, I have no objection to the overall direction.
wrong_choice_explanations: に限らず means 'not limited to X' and widens the scope to include X; 細かい点に限らず would extend the speaker's agreement to the details too, but the sentence sets the details aside and agrees only with the overall direction.
のみならず means 'not only X' and adds X to what follows; 細かい点のみならず would say the speaker agrees with the details as well, whereas はともかく leaves them out of the judgment.
はもちろん means 'X goes without saying, and…' and adds X to the praise; 細かい点はもちろん would say the details are obviously fine too, the opposite of setting them aside to talk about the overall plan.
exercises.hiragana_full: こまかいてんはともかく、ぜんたいのほうしんにはいろんはない。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 細部はともかく、大まかな方向性には異論はない。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: さいぶはともかく、おおまかなほうこうせいにはいろんはない。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 細かい部分は別として、基本方針には賛同できる。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: こまかいぶぶんはべつとして、きほんほうしんにはさんどうできる。

exercises.example_sentence: 動機はともかく、彼の提案は検討する価値がある。
exercises.translation: His motive aside, his proposal is worth considering.
wrong_choice_explanations: はもちろん means 'X goes without saying, and…' and adds X to the praise; 動機はもちろん would praise his motive too, whereas the sentence sets the motive aside and judges only the proposal itself.
ばかりか means 'not only X but also…' and adds X to what follows; 動機ばかりか would imply the motive is also worth considering, but the sentence deliberately leaves the motive out of the evaluation.
のみならず means 'not only X' and adds X to what follows; 動機のみならず would add the motive to what is worth considering, whereas はともかく sets it aside to focus on the proposal.
exercises.hiragana_full: どうきはともかく、かれのていあんはけんとうするかちがある。

audio_alternatives.kanji: きっかけはともかく、その案は一度議論してみよう。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: きっかけはともかく、そのあんはいちどぎろんしてみよう。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 動機は別として、彼のアイデアには見るべき点がある。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: どうきはべつとして、かれのあいであにはみるべきてんがある。

exercises.example_sentence: 好き嫌いはともかく、栄養のバランスを考えて食べなさい。
exercises.translation: Likes and dislikes aside, eat with nutritional balance in mind.
wrong_choice_explanations: に加えて means 'in addition to X' and stacks X on top of what follows; 好き嫌いに加えて would tell the child to consider their likes too, whereas the sentence sets likes and dislikes aside in favour of nutrition.
はもちろん means 'X goes without saying, and…' and adds X to the praise; 好き嫌いはもちろん would treat likes and dislikes as obviously important, the opposite of telling the child to set them aside.
に限らず means 'not limited to X' and widens the scope to include X; 好き嫌いに限らず would include likes and dislikes among the things to consider, but the point is to ignore them and eat a balanced diet.
exercises.hiragana_full: すききらいはともかく、えいようのばらんすをかんがえてたべなさい。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 好みはともかく、体のために栄養を考えて食べよう。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: このみはともかく、からだのためにえいようをかんがえてたべよう。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 好き嫌いは別として、しっかり栄養を取ることが大切だ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: すききらいはべつとして、しっかりえいようをとることがたいせつだ。

exercises.example_sentence: 立場はともかく、まずは相手の話を最後まで聞くべきだ。
exercises.translation: Your position aside, you should first hear the other person out to the end.
wrong_choice_explanations: はもちろん means 'X goes without saying, and…' and adds X to the praise; 立場はもちろん would make one's position matter too, whereas the sentence says to set it aside and simply hear the other person out.
のみならず means 'not only X' and adds X to what follows; 立場のみならず would add one's position to what should be considered, the opposite of setting it aside as はともかく does.
ばかりか means 'not only X but also…' and adds X to what follows; 立場ばかりか would treat one's position as something to weigh as well, but the advice is to put it aside and listen first.
exercises.hiragana_full: たちばはともかく、まずはあいてのはなしをさいごまできくべきだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 意見はともかく、まずは相手の主張を最後まで聞こう。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: いけんはともかく、まずはあいてのしゅちょうをさいごまできこう。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 賛否はともかく、最後まで話を聞くのが礼儀だ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: さんぴはともかく、さいごまではなしをきくのがれいぎだ。
